Here is a short summary of the Hartford gate kiosk incident on Monday, August 3, for your procurement colleagues.

- Outage: about 10:42 AM on Aug 3, both inbound gate lanes at the Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Recovery: kiosk 1 was back at 11:03 AM, and both lanes were confirmed working as of 11:07 AM.
- Status-page access: your login was still getting access denied on the status page. This is tracked in INC-4821, where the screenshot is attached. The last update in the incident record is from Aug 3, so please treat its status as needing confirmation.

I will confirm the current status of INC-4821 and send you an update.

Best,
Gideon Sato
Strategic Accounts, Pemberline Systems
